beats.text: Think you can spot AI slop? Most people can't.
Eleven thousand people took an online test. Fifty pictures. Human or AI?
The median score was sixty percent. Pure guessing gets you fifty.
The most liked picture in the whole test? Made by AI.
Even people who said they hate AI art put AI pieces in half of their top ten.
So maybe we don't hate slop. We hate knowing it's slop.

sources: Scott Alexander (2024), 'How Did You Do On The AI Art Turing Test?', Astral Codex Ten. ~11,000 participants, 50 images; median 60%, mean 60.6%; most popular picture 'Riverside Cafe' was AI; 1,278 people who rated AI art 1/5 still had 50% AI in their top ten. Voluntary online survey of blog readers, not peer-reviewed. Merriam-Webster Word of the Year 2025: slop.
